$comment: Human-readable schema for digest posts. The enforced rules live in scripts/digest-lib.mjs (npm run digest:check).
status: draft | published (drafts are never built, linked, fed or put in the sitemap)
title: 10-110 chars. Plain, specific, dated. No hype.
seo_title: 20-52 chars. Used for the <title> tag as "seo_title — coldchainOS". Short, specific, dated.
summary: 70-300 chars. Becomes the meta description and the feed summary.
takeaway: 20-280 chars. The pencil question for the day, in one sentence.
tags: 1-6 lowercase slugs, e.g. energy, regulation, security, real-estate, last-mile, datasets
published_at: ISO timestamp on the post date
method: 20-600 chars. How the digest was researched and what was and was not read.

items.headline: 10-140 chars
items.label: public | illustrative | founder | planned | hypothesis
items.what_happened: What the source documents, with its own dates and scope. 20-900 chars.
items.why_it_matters: Why it matters for cold-storage evidence and underwriting. 20-900 chars.
items.not_established: What it does NOT establish. 20-900 chars. Required.
items.review_question: A practical question for an accountable person. Must end with a question mark.

sources.title: Exact title
sources.published: Date as stated by the source
sources.accessed: YYYY-MM-DD (on or before the post date)
sources.kind: observed | estimated | forecast | regulatory | government advisory | draft guidance | final guidance | vendor announcement | survey estimate | projection | other
sources.qualification: What this source is not / limits
